notes.title: Chronovex - Update 11
notes.content:
🚀 Major Update Now Live!

New Content & Lore:

🔹 Added Intro Backstory – Immerse yourself from the start with a fresh narrative intro.

🔹 Added Backstory to Every Track – Each race track now features its own unique lore.

🔹 Added Ending Backstory – Wrap up your journey with a proper story conclusion.

Visual & UI Enhancements:

🖼️ Updated Track Images – All track thumbnails in the selection UI have been refreshed.

🌆 Enhanced Track Scenery – Multiple tracks now feature new buildings, vegetation, and world details.

🌟 Updated Lighting – Improved lighting across various tracks for a more immersive atmosphere.

🎮 Race UI Overhaul – New buttons added for camera filter, rearview, camera toggle, and more.

🎛️ Main Menu UI Refreshed – Sleeker and more intuitive.

🎨 New Default Camera Filter – Enjoy a fresh look right out of the gate.

Gameplay & Mechanics:

🤖 A.I. Adjustments – Tweaked difficulty levels for a better challenge on multiple tracks.

🛸 Ship Scale Changes – Multiple ships resized for improved visual consistency and gameplay.

🎨 Color Customization – Added buttons/keys for changing ship colors during selection.

Miscellaneous Updates:

🏁 Leaderboard Reset – Fresh competition awaits!

🎄 Holiday Content Removed – Seasonal ships and tracks have been rotated out.

🛠️ Countdown Audio Bug Fixed – That pesky audio glitch is no more.
